entities.summary: Jan Piotrowski is a Polish Roman Catholic bishop, being the archbishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kielce since 2014. He previously served as the auxiliary bishop of Tarnów and titular bishop of Sinitis from 2013 to 2014.
